info.description: Racket sports tournament management engine. Supports single elimination, round robin, and group + knockout formats with set-based scoring, three-way tiebreakers, BYE handling, and result correction.
info.title: BracketForge API

get.description: Returns a list of all organisations. This is primarily for testing and debugging purposes.

post.description: Creates a new organisation. This is the onboarding entry point — no auth required.

get.description: Returns the organisation for the authenticated user's org ID
Returns all players in the authenticated organisation

post.description: Creates a new player profile within the organisation. Admin or organizer only.

get.description: Returns a single player by ID

put.description: Updates name, email, or metadata for a player. Admin or organizer only.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a player from the organisation. Admin only.

get.description: Returns all tournaments belonging to the authenticated organisation

post.description: Creates a new tournament. Format must be one of: single_elimination, round_robin, group_knockout. BestOf must be 3 or 5.

get.description: Returns a single tournament by ID

Returns standings for a single group with the full tiebreaker cascade applied (head-to-head → mutual set ratio → mutual game ratio → overall set ratio → overall game ratio → draw). Each entry includes a rank field.
Returns a match with its full participant list and set-by-set scores

put.description: Voids the previous result, reverses standings contributions, and resubmits with corrected scores. Blocked if the next match in the bracket has already been completed. Admin only.

post.description: Records the full set-by-set result for a match. Validates set count against best_of, updates standings for group/round-robin stages, and advances the winner to the next bracket slot atomically.

patch.description: Sets the scheduled date and time for a match

get.description: Returns all registrations for a tournament including player names

post.description: Registers a player into a tournament. Tournament must be in draft or registration status.

patch.description: Updates a player's registration status. Setting withdrawn or disqualified while the tournament is active triggers the walkover engine for all pending matches.

get.description: Returns all stages for a tournament ordered by stage_order

post.description: Creates a stage within a tournament. Type must be one of: group, knockout, round_robin. Stage order controls the sequence (1 = first played).
Generates the match bracket for a knockout or round-robin stage. BYE matches are auto-completed. Use /draw for group stages instead.
Distributes registered players into groups using serpentine seeding and generates all round-robin matches within each group. Only valid for stages of type group.

get.description: Returns all matches for a stage ordered by round and position
Returns standings for all groups in a stage ordered by points. For group stages, use the group standings endpoint to get tiebreaker-resolved rankings per group.

patch.description: Moves the tournament through its lifecycle: draft → registration → active → completed. Each step must be taken in order.

post.description: Authenticates with email and password. Returns a JWT token to use in the Authorization header.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new user within the authenticated organisation. Admin only.

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token as: Bearer <token>
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
